about: Things that went in without being tried on a real screen. Whoever ships something untested adds a line here (newest first) and it shows on Server > Overview as 'Try these on a real screen'. Remove a line once it is old news.

items.title: Famous lists: a new tab on Movies and Shows with IMDb Top 250, Best Picture winners and Palme d'Or winners (Shows: IMDb Top 250 TV, Emmy winners for Best Drama and Best Comedy). Each row says how many you have, and titles not on Glowfin say Ask for it. Tower gathers the lists the first time it updates, which takes a few minutes
items.where: TV, phone and browser · Movies > Famous lists and Shows > Famous lists

items.title: Kids pages in the same layout: on a TV the Kids Home (and Guest Home) shows the big picture of the cover you're on behind everything, like the grown-up Home; the rows stay right where they were. The three Kids buttons are round pills now, and the rows are cover art only on TV
items.where: living room TV · pick Kids on Who's watching, move onto Keep watching and back up to the buttons

items.title: Press Up while watching (controls hidden) and the same Story and details panel as the title page slides in from the right: the story of what's playing (the episode's own story for a show), then studio, dates and genres. The video keeps playing; Back closes it. OK and Down still bring up the controls. Browser: press I
items.where: TV · play a movie and an episode, press Up; browser: press I

items.title: Friendly empty and error pages: pages with nothing to show or that couldn't load (Books helper, book lists, Music, Something went wrong, You're offline) now show a soft little picture with the page's icon, one plain sentence and one white button
items.where: TV, phone and browser · turn Tower's helper off or open a page with nothing in it

items.title: One focus look everywhere: the button the remote is on is solid white with the aqua ring, the poster or card you're on gets a white outline with a soft aqua ring, and nothing grows any more. The clock has a faint see-through pill so it reads on bright pictures
items.where: TV and browser · move around Home, a title page, Settings, Games and the player; look at the clock on a bright picture

items.title: New look on phones and tablets: Home, Movies, Shows, Anime, Music, Books and Games have no big picture at the top, the rows start right under the tabs, cover art only. Tablets and phones turned sideways now get this too (they had the TV top), with more covers across instead of bigger ones
items.where: a tablet, or a phone turned sideways · open Home, Movies, Music, Books and Games

items.title: New look for the side menu: the icon strip has its own soft fade that melts into the art; press Left and the same fade stretches wider while the names fade in (no slide), the page behind dims, the place you are on is a solid white pill with the aqua ring, the page you are on is aqua; Right or Back fades the names away
items.where: TV and browser · on Home press Left from the first cover, move up and down, then press Right; try Back too. Browser: point at the menu

items.title: New look for Search: one line of letters under the box (mic first, hold Delete to clear, 123 for numbers), recent searches as pills with a Browse genres and moods pill, Down tucks the letters away and the result you're on fills the screen, kind pills (Everything, Movies 6...) beside the box, and Ask for it first in yellow when nothing's on Glowfin
items.where: TV, phone and browser · open Search, type a few letters, press Down into the results, Up to get the letters back; press Back from a title and you should land on the same cover. Browser: just start typing or press /

items.title: New look for Requests (part 4): Ben's Manage board has see-through count pills, slim rows and the request you're on filling the right side (art, who asked, why it's stuck); family members see Your asks as rows of covers with dots, and Ben's reason when he said no; in the browser a small Ask button shows on a cover under the mouse
items.where: TV and browser · Ben: Requests > Manage, move down the rows. Family: Requests > Your asks. Browser: hover a poster that isn't on Glowfin yet

items.title: New look for Requests (part 3): Music and Books land on rows with the cover you're on big at the top right and its colours behind; Books starts with Series to finish; song and book ask panels have For: Me
items.where: TV, phone and browser · Requests > Music and Requests > Books (Ben: Bring in a playlist is a pill under the rows)

items.title: New look for Requests (part 2): Anime and Manga land on rows (This season, Top 10, This week in anime, Trending on AniList, Trending on MyAnimeList, Moods pills, Mix and match tags...) with the art of what you're on behind; Shows starts with New seasons for shows you watch; picking seasons opens a panel from the right with Every new season from now on
items.where: TV, phone and browser · open Requests > Anime and Manga, move along the rows; Requests > Shows, hold OK on a show (Ben: try Every new season on one show, Sonarr should show Monitor new seasons: All after you say yes)

items.title: New look for Requests (part 1): tabs are see-through pills with round Search and Filters and a yellow Waiting pill; Movies and Shows land on a row with the cover's art filling the screen, a coloured status tag and coloured dots on covers already asked for; Filters open in a right-hand panel; For: Me is on the ask page
items.where: TV, phone and browser · open Requests, move along the Movies row and stop, press Filters, open a title (Ben: For: Me is next to Ask for it)

items.title: New look for Settings, Help and the Server page: groups are see-through pills on the left (the open one solid white), settings sit in a tall right-hand panel over the dimmed last picture, the setting you're on is solid white with the aqua ring
items.where: TV, phone and browser · open Me > Settings, move down the groups and into a group, change a setting; then Help and the Server page

items.title: New look for Live TV and the player: Live TV opens on what's on now (big events and sports first) with Watch live, Full guide and Favourite, Down opens the full guide; player buttons are round with their names under them, Pause is solid white, the logo sits bottom left and Ends at sits under the clock; Volume only on the browser
items.where: TV, phone and browser · open Live TV, then play a show and press OK

items.title: New look for Music, Books and Games: cover of what you are on top right with its colours behind, name, facts and aqua tag on the left, cover art only in the rows, Ember Road has its own tab after For you; phones start right on the rows
items.where: TV, phone and browser · open Music, Books and Games, move along a row and stop, then open the Ember Road tab

items.title: Shrunk movies still play surround sound on the soundbar (big 5.1 tracks are now 5.1 at 384 kbps)
items.where: TV with soundbar · play a movie the shrinker did after Nov 23

items.title: New look for Home, Movies, Shows and Anime: art fills the screen, title box, facts, aqua tag, 2-line story, score pill top right, see-through tab pills; phones start right on the rows
items.where: TV, phone and browser · open Home, Movies, Shows and Anime, move along a row and stop
